ModMetaData.name: Reactor Slag
ModMetaData.author: Nahuel
ModMetaData.description:
When a heavy mechanoid falls, its core spills.
Kill a centipede, a tunneler or a centurion and a pool of white-hot slag opens under the wreck. It lights up the battlefield at night, smokes and spits sparks, and over three days cools from orange to red to a dull ember. When it goes cold it leaves a crust of slag on the ground: in the field it stays as a scar of the fight, in your base your colonists can clean it.
Mechanoid commanders (war queen, diabolus, apocriton) leave a larger pool and a brighter light.
- Any mechanoid race with a body size of 2.5 or more, or a boss: vanilla, DLC and modded mechs alike, of any faction. - Harmless: the pool does not burn, block or hurt anyone. The cold crust is ordinary filth (a little ugly, cleanable). - The light shrinks and reddens as the pool cools. - With Odyssey, the centre of a cooled pool turns into cooled lava, on natural ground only (never floors, water or growing zones). - Settings: cooling time, halo on/off, ground scar on/off.
No Harmony, no dependencies. Safe to add to an existing save.
